description: Work out an invoice's payment terms for accounts payable or receivable. Send the invoice date, the amount and the terms, either as text such as '2/10 net 30' or 'net 45', or as discount_percent, discount_days and net_days. Get back the discount deadline, the net due date, the discount in money, and, if you send pay_date, whether the discount applies, the amount to pay and the days late. Also the yearly cost of skipping the discount (simple and compounded, 365-day year), so you can decide whether to pay early. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/payment-terms-discount). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

amount.description: Invoice amount the discount applies to (in the invoice's currency).

discount_days.description: Days after the invoice date the discount is open.

invoice_date.description: Invoice date (terms count from it), YYYY-MM-DD.

label.description: Optional label for the invoice (your own text, echoed back; not a person).

net_days.description: Days after the invoice date the full amount is due.

pay_date.description: Optional: the date you pay or were paid, YYYY-MM-DD.

terms.description: Terms as text: '2/10 net 30', '1.5/15 n/45', 'net 30'. Leave out if you send the three numbers instead.

name: payment_terms_discount
title: Payment Terms and Early-Pay Discount
